raw_segments.text: Gentlemen, not to a rage, patience and sorrow strove who should express her goodliest.
You have seen sunshine and rain at once, her smiles and tears were like a better day.
Those happy smillets that played on her ripe lips seemed not to know what guests were in
her eyes, which parted thence as pearls from diamonds dropped.
In brief, sorrow would be a rarity most beloved if all could so become it.
